title: Predicate-Guided Generation for Mathematical Reasoning
paper_type_zh: 可执行符号推理数据发布与构造配方
best_for_zh: 研究数学数据构造、程序执行验证、predicate 复用与 RLVR 反馈边界的读者
one_line: Prolog-MATH translates 7,500 MATH training problems and CoTs into predicate-guided SWI-Prolog candidates, filters terminal answers symbolically, and applies SFT/GRPO recovery; the 97.4% paper union is not present as a reconciled public manifest.
Prolog-MATH 将 7,500 道 MATH 训练题及 CoT 转成 predicate-guided SWI-Prolog 候选，以终态符号等价筛选并用 SFT/GRPO 恢复失败；论文所述 97.4% 并集尚无可核对的公开清单。
why: It makes predicate reuse, typed outputs, execution filtering, retries, and program-level RL feedback concrete while exposing the difference between terminal correctness and faithful reasoning.
inclusion_reason: Prolog-MATH is an inspectable construction recipe for converting natural-language mathematics into reusable predicates and executable programs, filtering by terminal symbolic equivalence, and recovering failures with program-level RL feedback.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Natural-language chain-of-thought solutions are readable but do not supply executable semantics for checking either intermediate claims or the final transformation. Prolog-MATH asks whether the full 7,500-example MATH training set can be converted into declarative programs whose outputs are mechanically checked, while retaining reusable mathematical abstractions rather than producing an isolated program for every problem.

The intended construction object is richer than a prose rationale: a MATH problem and source CoT lead to suggested predicates, a candidate symbolic answer type, an executable Prolog program, an execution result, and a verifier decision. The paper uses this object for supervised fine-tuning and then treats initially failed problems as an RL search set.

Execution is only a terminal boundary. A program can print the gold answer while hard-coding a value, using an incomplete derivation, or departing from its predicate names and source CoT. The paper's own manual audit finds such coincidentally correct cases, so verified coverage must not be read as semantic fidelity.

自然语言 chain-of-thought 便于阅读，却没有可执行语义来检查中间主张或最终转换。Prolog-MATH 研究能否把全部 7,500 道 MATH 训练题转换成可机械核验输出的声明式程序，同时保留可跨题复用的数学抽象，而不是为每道题生成彼此孤立的程序。

目标构造对象比文字解答更丰富：MATH 问题及源 CoT 经过建议 predicates、候选符号答案类型、可执行 Prolog 程序、执行结果和 verifier 判定，形成可用于监督微调的数据对象；初始失败题则进一步成为 RL 搜索集合。

执行只构成终态边界。程序可能在硬编码数值、推导不完整、偏离 predicate 名义或源 CoT 的同时打印出 gold answer。论文自己的人工审计给出了这种“偶然正确”案例，因此 verified coverage 不能等同于语义忠实度。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The construction has two generation stages. Stage 1 asks DeepSeek-V3 to propose problem-specific predicates from the problem, its CoT, predefined operators, and an evolving library. Definitions that pass a SWI-Prolog syntax check enter a shared buffer; names can be reused in later prompts, and frequently invoked predicates can be promoted into the canonical set.

Stage 2 supplies the problem, CoT, selected predicates, and candidate symbolic answer types, then generates a complete program. SWI-Prolog executes the program and an adapted Math-Verify checker compares the output with the gold answer using structured-term conversion, normalization, parsing, symbolic equivalence, or numerical tolerance. A failed item receives up to three decoding attempts with varied temperature.

This initial pipeline verifies 6,100 of 7,500 problems, or 81.3%. SFT followed by GRPO searches the failed set, and verified successes from four recovery models are unioned. The paper reports a further 16.1 percentage points and 97.4% total coverage; the live public release at the pinned revision contains 6,093 rows rather than an item-level manifest of that union.

构造流程分两阶段。Stage 1 让 DeepSeek-V3 根据问题、对应 CoT、预定义 operators 和持续演化的 library 提议问题专用 predicates。能够通过 SWI-Prolog 语法检查的定义进入共享 buffer；其名称可在后续 prompt 中复用，频繁调用的 predicates 还可晋升到 canonical set。

Stage 2 输入问题、CoT、选定 predicates 与候选符号答案类型，生成完整程序。SWI-Prolog 执行程序，改造后的 Math-Verify checker 再通过结构化 term 转换、规范化、解析、符号等价或数值容差，将输出与 gold answer 比较。失败实例最多获得三次不同 temperature 的解码尝试。

初始流程验证 7,500 题中的 6,100 题，即 81.3%。随后以 SFT 和 GRPO 搜索失败集，并合并四个恢复模型的 verified successes。论文报告额外增加 16.1 个百分点，总覆盖率达到 97.4%；但固定 revision 的当前公开发布只有 6,093 行，并不是该并集的逐条清单。

title: Method
方法
html:
Predicate induction is stateful. Algorithm 1 stores validated definitions in a shared buffer, reuses names across problems, materializes definitions when needed, and promotes frequently invoked predicates. A generated row can therefore depend on a changing library, but the public release does not identify the buffer version or construction order.

Program generation is type-aware: the prompt enumerates forms for numbers, fractions, equations, expressions, intervals, solution sets, vectors, matrices, trigonometric values, formatted numbers, units, and other structured answers. On MATH-500, the paper reports 68.2% verified accuracy for the complete two-stage predicate-and-type system, 41.6% for one-stage generation without predicate guidance, and 26.3% when the two-stage system omits answer types.

For GRPO, the paper defines program-level rewards of 2.0 for a correct clean program, 1.9 for a correct program with a singleton-predicate penalty, 0.5 for an incorrect program that invokes all suggested predicates, and 0 otherwise. The pinned public training script uses Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with rank-32 LoRA, 4-bit loading, six generations per prompt, a device batch of six, eight-step accumulation, 3e-6 learning rate, and 20 epochs. Its implementation gives partial credit when any suggested predicate is detected, which is weaker than the paper's “all predicates” condition.

The public 6,093-row split exposes only instruction, input, output, domain, answer, and predicates. Original CoT, MATH ID, generator, retry number, execution log, parsed result, verifier components, reward, rejection history, and recovery lineage are not row fields.

Predicate induction 带有状态。Algorithm 1 把验证后的定义存入共享 buffer，在不同题目之间复用名称，按需展开定义，并提升高频 predicates。因此单条生成记录可能依赖不断变化的 library，但公开发布没有记录 buffer 版本或构造顺序。

程序生成显式考虑答案类型：prompt 枚举数字、分数、方程、表达式、区间、解集、向量、矩阵、三角函数值、格式化数字、单位等结构化形式。论文在 MATH-500 上报告：完整的两阶段 predicate-and-type 系统 verified accuracy 为 68.2%，取消 predicate guidance 的单阶段生成是 41.6%，两阶段系统去掉 answer-type list 后是 26.3%。

对 GRPO，论文把程序级 reward 定义为：答案正确且结构干净给 2.0；正确但有 singleton-predicate penalty 给 1.9；答案错误但调用全部建议 predicates 给 0.5；其余给 0。固定版本的公开训练脚本使用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、rank-32 LoRA、4-bit 加载、每题六次生成、device batch 6、八步累积、3e-6 learning rate 和 20 epochs。实现中的 partial credit 只要求检测到任意一个建议 predicate，比论文的“全部 predicates”条件更弱。

公开的 6,093 行 split 只有 instruction、input、output、domain、answer 和 predicates。源 CoT、MATH ID、生成器、重试序号、执行日志、解析结果、verifier 分量、reward、拒绝历史和恢复谱系都不是逐行字段。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The construction evidence is internally consistent at the paper level: 6,100/7,500 items pass the initial pipeline; the four recovery models add 9.7, 14.9, 15.2, and 15.7 points individually; their union adds 16.1 points to reach 97.4%. At 2,000 GRPO steps on the DeepSeek-V3 failure set, predicate-aware reward improves coverage by 9.7 points versus 7.8 for binary reward. These figures describe the reported generation runs, not the size or quality of the current release.

The ablation establishes that the tested pipeline uses both staged predicates and answer-type prompts: its MATH-500 verified accuracy is 68.2%, versus 41.6% without staged predicate generation and 26.3% without the answer-type list. A same-configuration SFT comparison reports 36.8% after training on Prolog-MATH and 33.2% after training on the original MATH CoTs. Neither benchmark result verifies every released program or attributes all gains to data quality.

The strongest negative evidence is the manual audit. Of 100 two-stage programs, 96 are judged mathematically correct or reasonable; of 100 Qwen2.5-3B GRPO programs, 90 have correct logic. Appendix G shows a two-stage solution that makes a false digit assumption but reaches the right answer, and a GRPO program that considers only the factor 167 of 2004 while coincidentally returning the correct exponent 12. Terminal equivalence therefore has a measurable semantic gap.

Official artifacts expose pipeline, SFT, GRPO, reward, and verifier code, plus a live 6,093-row Hugging Face split. They also reveal reproducibility drift: the standalone generation script uses substring output matching rather than the paper's adapted symbolic checker, and several scripts still require user-supplied paths, endpoints, or checkpoints.

在论文层面，构造证据可以相互对应：初始流程通过 6,100/7,500 题；四个恢复模型单独增加 9.7、14.9、15.2 和 15.7 个百分点；合并后增加 16.1 个百分点，达到 97.4%。在 DeepSeek-V3 失败集上训练 2,000 步时，predicate-aware reward 把覆盖率提高 9.7 个百分点，binary reward 为 7.8。这些数字描述论文中的生成运行，不代表当前公开发布的规模或逐条质量。

消融结果说明被测 pipeline 同时依赖分阶段 predicates 和 answer-type prompts：完整系统在 MATH-500 上的 verified accuracy 为 68.2%，取消分阶段 predicate generation 后为 41.6%，去掉 answer-type list 后为 26.3%。相同配置的 SFT 对照报告 Prolog-MATH 为 36.8%，原始 MATH CoTs 为 33.2%。两类 benchmark 结果都不能验证每个公开程序，也不能把全部收益归因于数据质量。

最重要的负面证据来自人工审计。100 个两阶段程序中有 96 个被判断为数学上正确或合理；100 个 Qwen2.5-3B GRPO 程序中有 90 个逻辑正确。Appendix G 展示了一例两阶段程序：错误假设末三位数字的构成却得到正确答案；另一例 GRPO 程序只考虑 2004 的因子 167，却偶然返回正确指数 12。终态等价与语义健全之间因此存在可测差距。

官方制品公开了 pipeline、SFT、GRPO、reward 与 verifier 代码，以及一个可访问的 6,093 行 Hugging Face split。它们也暴露出复现漂移：standalone generation script 使用字符串包含匹配，而非论文描述的改造符号 checker；若干脚本仍要求用户自行提供路径、endpoint 或 checkpoint。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is the linked construction recipe rather than Prolog, execution filtering, or GRPO in isolation. Predicate suggestion precedes full synthesis; an evolving library supports reuse across problems; a fixed vocabulary of symbolic answer types is part of both generation and verification; and failed examples are not simply discarded but become a recovery set for SFT and GRPO.

The predicate-aware reward adds program-level structural feedback without human preference labels or a learned process model. Correct output is combined with a singleton-warning penalty and suggested-predicate use. Its boundary is explicit: an incorrect program can earn 0.5, and no intermediate mathematical claim receives an independent label.

For the Data Construction and Open Release track, the important design distinction is among source reasoning, reusable abstraction, executable artifact, terminal equivalence, and recovery provenance. Prolog-MATH makes these stages visible in the paper, but the public table collapses accepted results into six fields and does not release the rejected candidates or state of the predicate library.

贡献在于相互连接的构造 recipe，而不是单独发明 Prolog、execution filtering 或 GRPO。Predicate suggestion 先于完整程序合成；持续演化的 library 支持跨题复用；固定的 symbolic answer type 词表同时参与生成与验证；失败实例也不是直接丢弃，而是转为 SFT 与 GRPO 的恢复集合。

Predicate-aware reward 在不使用人类偏好标签或 learned process model 的情况下加入程序级结构反馈：终态正确性与 singleton-warning penalty、建议 predicate 使用情况共同决定 reward。边界也很明确：错误程序仍可获得 0.5，且没有任何中间数学步骤得到独立认证。

对 Data Construction and Open Release track，关键设计区别在于源推理、可复用抽象、可执行制品、终态等价和恢复谱系。Prolog-MATH 在论文中展示了这些阶段，但公开表把已接受结果压平为六个字段，没有发布被拒候选或 predicate library 的状态。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Terminal-verification boundary: the checker validates the final output, not program-to-CoT faithfulness or the truth of intermediate reasoning. Appendix G contains accepted, correct-answer programs with flawed or incomplete logic; the manual pass rates are 96/100 for two-stage outputs and 90/100 for GRPO outputs.
  • Predicate and reward boundary: Stage 1 syntax validation only establishes that definitions compile. The paper's 0.5 partial reward intentionally favors predicate alignment even when the answer is wrong, while the pinned implementation tests overlap with any suggested predicate rather than use of all suggested predicates.
  • Checker risk: the acceptance path depends on Prolog-term conversion, LaTeX parsing, normalization, numerical tolerance, prefix fallbacks, and hand-written special cases. The paper reports no calibrated false-accept or false-reject rate across answer types.
  • Release mismatch: the paper reports 6,100 initial programs and a 97.4% union; pinned Hub revision 0aa6c9783d698ea3fbe5e71a76cfb01d2cd0d5af has one 6,093-row train split, while its prose says the dataset is disabled and lists 7,923 training examples. No official row manifest maps these counts.
  • Lineage loss: public rows omit MATH IDs, source CoTs, buffer version, generator, attempt number, execution output, verifier verdict, reward components, failed candidates, and recovery model. The released file cannot reconstruct the search or distinguish initial from recovered examples.
  • Reproducibility and rights: public scripts require user-supplied configuration and the standalone pipeline checker differs from the paper method. The dataset is tagged MIT and the paper calls MATH MIT, but the pinned code tree has no license file. Exact paper-run temperatures, seeds, and total generation budget remain unknown.
  • Evaluation scope: MATH train supplies the corpus and MATH-500 supplies the main ablation. No broader duplicate, overlap, or pretraining-contamination audit is reported, and benchmark improvement is not proof of record-level quality.

• 终态验证边界： checker 验证最终输出，不验证程序是否忠于源 CoT，也不判断中间推理是否成立。Appendix G 给出了最终答案正确但逻辑错误或不完整的已接受程序；两阶段输出与 GRPO 输出的人工逻辑通过率分别为 96/100 和 90/100。
  • Predicate 与 reward 边界： Stage 1 语法验证只说明定义可以编译。论文有意给“答案错误但符合 predicate 使用条件”的程序 0.5 分，而固定版本实现只检查是否与任意建议 predicate 重叠，并非论文所写的全部 predicates。
  • Checker 风险： 接受路径依赖 Prolog term 转换、LaTeX 解析、规范化、数值容差、prefix fallback 和手写 special cases。论文没有报告不同答案类型上的校准误接受率或误拒绝率。
  • 发布不一致： 论文报告 6,100 个初始程序与 97.4% 并集；固定 Hub revision 0aa6c9783d698ea3fbe5e71a76cfb01d2cd0d5af 只有一个 6,093 行 train split，但数据集文字同时声称数据被禁用且 train 有 7,923 个样本。没有官方逐行 manifest 对齐这些数字。
  • 谱系丢失： 公开记录缺少 MATH ID、源 CoT、buffer 版本、生成器、尝试序号、执行输出、verifier 判定、reward 分量、失败候选和恢复模型。因此无法重建搜索过程，也无法区分初始样本与恢复样本。
  • 复现与权利： 公开脚本需要用户自行配置，standalone pipeline checker 与论文方法不同。数据集标记为 MIT，论文也称 MATH 为 MIT，但固定代码树中没有 license file。论文运行的精确 temperature、random seeds 和总生成预算仍为 unknown。
  • 评测范围： MATH train 提供构造语料，MATH-500 提供主要消融评测。论文没有报告更广泛的重复、重叠或预训练污染审计；benchmark 提升也不能证明逐条记录质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release track, Prolog-MATH is most useful as a construction and verifier audit case. It provides a concrete decomposition of problem sourcing, predicate induction, shared-library reuse, answer-type prompting, program synthesis, SWI-Prolog execution, symbolic filtering, retries, supervised warm-starting, and GRPO recovery.

A stronger release following this recipe would preserve an immutable MATH ID, source CoT and gold answer, predicate-buffer revision, proposed and materialized predicates, generator and decoding settings, every candidate program, raw stdout and stderr, parsed answer, verifier components, keep/reject reason, reward components, recovery model, and final union membership. Retaining rejected candidates would make both the verifier boundary and recovery process auditable.

Reuse class: blocked pending verification for direct training. The public file is useful for schema inspection, small controlled SFT trials, and verifier stress tests after pinning the Hub revision, independently rerunning programs, checking source and code rights, and reconciling counts. It should not be treated as the paper's complete 97.4% union or as process-supervision data.

Useful studies include testing final-answer equivalence against human program review, comparing all-predicate versus any-predicate partial reward, measuring false acceptance by symbolic answer type, and ablating source CoT, shared-buffer state, retries, and recovery models. Report release revision, executable environment, checker commit, pass/fail counts, and manual logic error rates separately from MATH-500 accuracy.

对 Data Construction and Open Release track，Prolog-MATH 最适合作为构造与 verifier 审计案例。它把问题来源、predicate induction、共享 library 复用、answer-type prompting、程序合成、SWI-Prolog 执行、符号筛选、重试、监督 warm-start 和 GRPO 恢复拆成了可分析的模块。

若按此 recipe 做更强的发布，应保留不可变 MATH ID、源 CoT 与 gold answer、predicate-buffer revision、提议及实体化 predicates、生成器与解码设置、每个候选程序、原始 stdout/stderr、解析答案、verifier 分量、保留或拒绝理由、reward 分量、恢复模型和最终并集成员关系。同步发布被拒候选，才能审计 verifier 边界与恢复过程。

复用等级：直接训练前仍被核验项阻挡。当前公开文件可用于 schema 检查、小规模受控 SFT 和 verifier stress test，但前提是固定 Hub revision、独立重跑程序、核对源数据及代码权利并对齐各项计数。不能把它视为论文完整的 97.4% 并集，也不能当作 process-supervision 数据。

可执行研究包括：比较 final-answer equivalence 与人工程序审查；比较 all-predicate 和 any-predicate partial reward；按 symbolic answer type 测量误接受；消融源 CoT、共享 buffer 状态、重试和恢复模型。应把 release revision、执行环境、checker commit、通过或失败数量和人工逻辑错误率，与 MATH-500 accuracy 分开报告。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 2–3 with Algorithm 1: the data object includes a changing shared predicate buffer, type-aware program generation, SWI-Prolog execution, and a terminal verifier, not merely problem–program pairs.
  • Use Tables 1–3 as construction and recovery evidence under reported setups; do not infer public-release size or semantic program quality from coverage or MATH-500 accuracy.
  • Read Appendix E beside the pinned reward code: the paper requires all suggested predicates for 0.5 partial credit, while the released implementation detects any overlap.
  • Treat Appendix G as essential negative evidence. Correct final answers can coexist with false assumptions or incomplete factor reasoning, and manual logic pass rates are below automatic acceptance.
  • Pin GitHub commit d01ae636df27f5ae52b6d59616cb757555a7862c and Hub revision 0aa6c9783d698ea3fbe5e71a76cfb01d2cd0d5af; reconcile the paper, viewer, and dataset-prose counts before reuse.
  • Distinguish the paper verifier from the standalone pipeline script's substring check, and independently execute a stratified sample across symbolic answer types.

• 把 Sections 2–3 与 Algorithm 1 连起来读：数据对象包含变化中的共享 predicate buffer、type-aware 程序生成、SWI-Prolog 执行和终态 verifier，不只是 problem–program pairs。
  • 将 Tables 1–3 视为特定设置下的构造与恢复证据；不要从 coverage 或 MATH-500 accuracy 推导公开规模或程序语义质量。
  • 对照阅读 Appendix E 与固定版本 reward code：论文的 0.5 partial credit 要求使用全部建议 predicates，而公开实现检测任意重叠。
  • 把 Appendix G 当作必要的负面证据。正确终态答案可以与错误假设或不完整的因子推理并存，人工逻辑通过率也低于自动接受率。
  • 固定 GitHub commit d01ae636df27f5ae52b6d59616cb757555a7862c 与 Hub revision 0aa6c9783d698ea3fbe5e71a76cfb01d2cd0d5af；复用前先对齐论文、viewer 与数据集文字中的计数。
  • 区分论文 verifier 与 standalone pipeline script 的 substring check，并按 symbolic answer type 分层抽样独立执行。

value.html: The 7,500 MATH training problems with natural-language chain-of-thought solutions and gold answers.

The paper-level object pairs a problem and source CoT with predicates, a typed executable Prolog program, and a checked symbolic answer. The pinned public release exposes instruction, input, output, domain, answer, and predicates only.
DeepSeek-V3 is the primary predicate and program generator; SFT/GRPO recovery is reported with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B.
SWI-Prolog execution followed by symbolic-answer comparison adapted from Math-Verify.

Final program output is compared with the gold answer after structured-term conversion, normalization, parsing, symbolic equivalence, or numerical tolerance. GRPO adds program-level correctness, singleton-warning, and suggested-predicate-use signals; no intermediate step is independently supervised.

A candidate executes and its parsed final output matches the gold answer under the configured checker. This does not certify that its predicates implement their names, that its intermediate logic is sound, or that it follows the source CoT.
The primary recovery run starts from a rank-32 LoRA-finetuned Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model loaded in 4-bit; additional 7B/8B recovery backbones are reported.
DeepSeek-V3 for the primary two-stage construction; GPT-4o is evaluated as an alternative generator.

Stage 1 proposes predicates from the problem, CoT, predefined operators, and a shared predicate buffer. Syntax-valid definitions can enter the buffer and frequently reused predicates can become canonical. Stage 2 conditions on the problem, CoT, selected predicates, and candidate symbolic answer types to synthesize a complete program.

The first pass verifies 6,100 of 7,500 MATH training items. GRPO searches the failed set; verified successes from four recovery models are unioned, with the paper reporting a 16.1-point gain and 97.4% total coverage.
Six generations per prompt in the pinned public GRPO training script; whether this exactly matches every paper run is unknown.
Varied across paper retries; exact values are unknown. The released generation scripts set 0.3 for their API calls.

Execute with SWI-Prolog, compare final output to gold with the adapted symbolic checker, retry each failed instance up to K=3 decoding attempts with varied temperature, and retain verified programs. The released standalone pipeline script instead uses substring matching, so it is not an exact executable specification of the paper checker.
Paper retries are capped at three decoding attempts per failed instance and the primary comparison is reported at 2,000 training steps. Seeds and total corpus-generation calls are unknown.

The pinned training script uses TRL/Unsloth GRPO, rank-32 LoRA, 4-bit loading, six generations, a 6-example device batch, eight-step accumulation, 3e-6 learning rate, and 20 epochs. The paper reward values are 2.0, 1.9, 0.5, and 0 according to terminal correctness and predicate structure.
MATH train is the stated sole prompt backbone. Public rows omit original MATH IDs, source CoTs, generator identity, attempt number, predicate-buffer version, and recovery-model lineage.

The paper reports 6,100 initial verified programs and a 97.4% recovery union. At pinned Hugging Face revision 0aa6c9783d698ea3fbe5e71a76cfb01d2cd0d5af, the live viewer exposes one 6,093-row train split, while the dataset prose says both that the release is disabled and that train has 7,923 examples. No immutable item-level manifest reconciles these surfaces.
MATH train supplies construction prompts and MATH-500 supplies the main ablation evaluation. No broader source-overlap, duplicate, or pretraining-contamination audit is reported.

items: Final-answer equivalence can accept a program with flawed or incomplete reasoning; Appendix G documents coincidentally correct examples in both the two-stage and GRPO samples.
Predicate compilation checks syntax, not whether a definition is mathematically faithful to its name or source CoT.

The paper grants 0.5 reward to an incorrect program that invokes all suggested predicates; the pinned code grants partial credit when any suggested predicate is detected, a release-versus-paper mismatch.
Structured-term conversion, LaTeX parsing, numerical tolerance, prefix fallbacks, and hand-coded special cases define the acceptance boundary and can create false accepts or rejects.
Manual review judged 96 of 100 two-stage programs and 90 of 100 Qwen2.5-3B GRPO programs mathematically reasonable, so automatic acceptance is not semantic certification.
Counts conflict and the release omits failed candidates, execution logs, verifier components, retry settings, and recovery provenance.
Public scripts retain unresolved user-supplied paths and endpoints; the standalone generation checker also differs from the paper's adapted Math-Verify description.

value.html: The paper describes the MATH source as MIT and the Hugging Face release is tagged MIT. No license file appears in the pinned code repository tree, so code reuse rights are not established by this Card.

MATH problem, CoT, and gold answer to predicate proposal and syntax validation to shared-buffer reuse to typed program synthesis to SWI-Prolog execution and symbolic filtering to retries to SFT/GRPO recovery to verified union. The public six-column table flattens this lineage.
